import json, sys

with open('/var/folders/pq/c_ny9d650l5b915rtjcq_sww0000gn/T/tmp.pQ64TzD7sr/manifest.json') as f:
    m = json.load(f)

# Models
print('=== MODELS ===')
for k, v in m.get('nodes', {}).items():
    if v.get('resource_type') in ('model', 'test'):
        cfg = v.get('config', {})
        print(json.dumps({
            'unique_id': v.get('unique_id'),
            'resource_type': v.get('resource_type'),
            'materialized': cfg.get('materialized'),
            'relation_name': v.get('relation_name'),
            'unique_key': cfg.get('unique_key'),
            'cluster_by': cfg.get('cluster_by'),
            'original_file_path': v.get('original_file_path'),
            'depends_on_nodes': v.get('depends_on', {}).get('nodes', []),
            'language': v.get('language'),
        }))

print()
print('=== SOURCES ===')
for k, v in m.get('sources', {}).items():
    print(json.dumps({
        'unique_id': v.get('unique_id'),
        'relation_name': v.get('relation_name'),
    }))

print()
print('=== CHILD_MAP (excerpt) ===')
cm = m.get('child_map', {})
for k, children in cm.items():
    if children:
        print(json.dumps({k: children}))

print()
print('=== EXPOSURES ===')
for k, v in m.get('exposures', {}).items():
    print(json.dumps({
        'unique_id': v.get('unique_id'),
        'depends_on_nodes': v.get('depends_on', {}).get('nodes', []),
    }))
